commands.review_summary:
The PR replaces fixed Control UI content font sizes in base, Settings, Quick Settings, and chat text CSS with values derived from the existing text-scale variable.

PR surface: Source +5. Total +5 across 4 files.

Reproducibility: yes. Source inspection gives a high-confidence path: `applyTextScale` writes the scale variable, and the PR makes touch-primary config inputs use a scaled 16px token that computes to 14.4px at the 90% stop; I did not run a live mobile Safari tap/zoom proof in this read-only review.

target.title: fix(web): apply Control UI text size to content typography
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the Appearance text size control persisted a selected value but only visibly affected a narrow part of Control UI typography. Users choosing S, XL, or XXL could still see Settings and most content text rendered at fixed sizes.

## Why This Change Was Made

This PR applies the existing `--control-ui-text-scale` token to the Control UI content typography surface: body text, Settings/Appearance forms and cards, quick settings rows, chat message tables/code, and the chat composer. The scope intentionally keeps shell/tool chrome geometry stable rather than scaling every topbar/sidebar control.

## User Impact

In this PR, changing Text size in Appearance produces a visible typography change across the main reading and composing surfaces while preserving the existing layout structure.

## Evidence

Validated locally:

- `git diff --check`
- Rebased `brzezowski/text-size-behavior` onto `origin/main` and pushed with lease; PR head is `77be1019cd7495e7f868e6888d1f869f7b5b16de`.
- Browser smoke with a local CSS harness for S (`0.9`) and XXL (`1.4`): Settings heading changed from `13.5px` to `21px`, chat text from `12.6px` to `19.6px`, quick setting labels from `11.7px` to `18.2px`, and composer text from `16px` to `19.6px`; no horizontal overflow was reported.
- Screenshot harness against the Vite-served PR CSS at XXL (`--control-ui-text-scale: 1.4`): settings title `21px`, chat text `19.6px`, composer text `19.6px`, no horizontal overflow.

In this PR, desktop XXL text-size proof:

![Desktop screenshot showing XXL Control UI text scaling across Appearance, quick settings, chat text, and composer](https://bold-castle-rdcg.here.now/openclaw-pr-100934-desktop-xxl.png)

In this PR, mobile XXL text-size proof:

![Mobile screenshot showing XXL Control UI text scaling across Appearance, quick settings, chat text, and composer](https://bold-castle-rdcg.here.now/openclaw-pr-100934-mobile-xxl.png)

Not run:

- Focused Vitest tests.
- `oxfmt`, because no `oxfmt` binary is available in this worktree.
